title: Deeper/broader FreeCAD importer-scope and ACIS-writer candidate refresh
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan/source reconciliation
scope: Recheck FreeCAD's current DXF importer routes, documented entity scopes, and stock ACIS/SAT limitation
Recheck the disposition of FreeCAD issue #28905 and the ACadSharp ACIS writer candidates #1150 and #1240
Reconcile those findings with local modeler DXF syntax tests and refine only the existing PAR-07/S8 composed gate

sources.observation: The documentation describes separate C++ and legacy Python DXF importers, both supporting R12 onward but with different listed entity scopes; the C++ importer omits text/dimensions/attributes inside blocks, the legacy importer lists 3DFACE, and stock FreeCAD cannot read ACIS/SAT solids. DWG is converted externally to DXF before the selected importer reads it.
sources.limits: Documentation is a route description, not runtime evidence for a specific future build or selected importer configuration.

sources.observation: The report initially described mirrored blocks in a pinned development build; the reporter later closed it after concluding the supplied DXF was corrupted.
sources.limits: The issue does not establish valid-file INSERT transform semantics or a libdxfrw defect; its attachment was not downloaded or admitted as a fixture.

sources.observation: Issue #1195 reports silent modeler-entity omission in a named older package. PR #1150 remains open and undeployed; its discussion says it conflicts with the later ACDS/ACIS refactor and reports a repeated-group-310 readback issue, while the maintainer prefers a schema-driven writer. Separate PR #1240 remains open and is not a released positive route.
sources.limits: Candidate branch descriptions and author-reported TrueView checks were not reproduced, are not normative format authority, and do not establish current released behavior.

sources.observation: The generated ASCII/Binary modeler matrix enumerates AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1027 and asserts ordered modeler groups/chunks plus the versioned 3DSOLID history pair.
sources.limits: No local build/test ran in this pass. Generated syntax coverage does not establish native acceptance, DXF-wide support, or ACIS semantic correctness.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Refined the existing PAR-07/S8 native-consumer gate to pin the FreeCAD build, importer backend, converter identity, and per-source-entity disposition; ACIS/SAT remains an expected unsupported stock-FreeCAD route and cannot be used as a B-rep semantic result. Reconciled open ACadSharp writer proposals as design leads only and noted already-present local generated versioned syntax coverage.

method.limitations: Project documentation and issue/PR discussion establish only declared route scope and reported candidate status. No peer artifact was built/run, no FreeCAD build was tested, and the reported malformed/real-world drawings were not downloaded or inspected.

validation.commitBlocker: No commit was requested; the worktree has extensive pre-existing user changes and Git metadata is read-only in this session.
